reviews.review:
A fun game even if you do not like war hammer, with cool executions and a good story. This game is one of my favourites and I wish I could play all the time if I could

The multiplayer is fun but there aren't many people on anymore but is still fun when you find a game and has a good customisation options.

10/10    :)

Great controls and an overall very high production value. Be a space marine and smash everything that dares to insult the Emperor by existing. Does what it says on the box. Tactical options are limited and the game can sometimes feel repetitive but combat remains satisfying throughout. The game does a good job of capturing the 40k universe through great levels and classic character tropes. Unfortunately the story is mind-numbingly predictable, but that is the case more often than not with 40k.

If any game in this IP deserves an expanded and beefed up sequel, it's this one.
Like killing thousands of enemies in bloody and visceral ways? I may have the game for you.

I can't really disagree with anyone here. To be honest, Space Marine was a good game(the single player was actually worth taking on, simply because of the storyline and game workshop forbids storylines that actually makes sense, but this one was actually pretty good.) The downside though is that its just hack and slash with shooting, but that's even satisfying when you mow down hordes of orcs and kick chaos in the face. It is just single player though and it didn't have any replayability(unless you want to do the achievements)

The multiplayer is fun, especially the extreminatus, but it doesn't really provide much, after 6 hours of the multiplayer, I think I had enough of it. I love the anesthetics though, and how you can customize your character.

Anyways, yeah, I would buy any sequel of this in a heartbeat, but ever since THQ went bankrupt, that's quite unlikely and SEGA would rely more on the RTS genre I think(In my opinion). Its a good game out of the rest of warhammer games out there(I'm looking at you fire warrior) Its worth buying, but only the original version of the game. The DLC's are ♥♥♥♥.
